description: Frappe message contains schema/data/meta; errors contain schema/error/meta. POST Idempotency-Key must equal operation_id and X-Frappe-CSRF-Token is required for authenticated session commands.

EpUnitManifest.title: Cipher independent canonical master/dimension manifest v1
EpUnitManifest.$comment: Structural interchange schema. Server validator additionally enforces exact references, scoped company, reduced rational factors, conversion consistency, precision and current authorization.

assignees.description: Current reads and new commands supply canonical active assignees. Historical immutable receipts may omit this additive field.

assignment_conflict.description: Current native assignment reconciliation state; historical immutable receipts may omit this additive field.

CurrentTask.description: Current Task mutation result. Unlike historical Task receipts, active canonical assignment projection and reconciliation state are always present.

job_operation_id.description: Reference to the existing rebuild operation; this read does not create a command.

FoEnvelope.description: Immutable Project capture attribution; device ownership/current authority and exact source/base revision facts are verified by the server. Canonical UTF-8 JSON is limited to 256 KiB by the service.
